schema.title: Response Health Api V1 Health Get

get.description:
Readiness: the database answers `SELECT 1`.

`storage` is `degraded` when the asset directory is not the one the
database's assets were stored in (see `app.assets.fingerprint`). It is
reported, not enforced: the status code stays 200, so a wrong mount does
not take the maps out of rotation. `STORAGE_FAIL_FAST` stops the start
instead.

Deliberately does NOT call Moodle: the app degrades gracefully when Moodle
is down, so a Moodle outage must not take instances out of rotation.

post.description:
Body `{"assertion": "<JWS>"}`. 401 `launch_invalid` for every
verification failure (the reason is only logged), 403 `tenant_disabled`,
429 `rate_limited`.

put.description:
Needs `If-Match: "<revision>"` (428 without, 412 when stale). 422
`trainer_settings_invalid` with `errors[{path, rule, message_key}]`; a save
that names content which is not published yet succeeds with `warnings`.

Replaces the 3D scene and its zone bindings; a `null` body removes the
3D view. Needs `If-Match: "<revision>"` (428 without, 412 when stale);
422 `scene_unknown` / `zone_out_of_range` / `duplicate_zone` /
`duplicate_bubble` / `bubble_not_in_map`.

patch.description:
`If-Match: "<version>"` is required unless the body is only `status`
(live demo data), which neither needs nor bumps the version.

post.description:
`draftHash` is the hash the editor reviewed. 409 `draft_changed_since_review`
if the draft moved, 409 `no_changes_to_publish`, 422 `publish_invalid`.

Puts the current publication back into the draft. Needs
`If-Match: "<revision>"`; 409 `never_published` if nothing was published.

Loads an older publication into the draft (it does NOT publish). Needs
`If-Match: "<revision>"`.

201 with the new asset, or 200 with the existing one when the same
content of the same kind was already uploaded (its title and credit are
left as they were). Optional form fields: `title`, `credit`.

Audio (`kind=audio`) also needs `title`, `credit` and `rightsDeclared=true`
(the uploader's declaration that they have the rights); `license` is
optional. An audio upload may carry a `cover` file (PNG, JPEG or WebP); with
none, the picture inside the audio is used if there is one, and
`warnings` says `cover_dropped` when it could not be.

A document (`kind=document`) is a PDF for welcome-flow steps: it needs a
`title` (up to 200 characters) and `rightsDeclared=true`. It is checked for
encryption, page count (at most 200) and active content, and stored as
uploaded. Documents are reachable by their unguessable URL like every
asset: they must not hold confidential material.

`scope=tenant` (default): this tenant's own uploads. `scope=library`:
the operator's audio library, readable by every tenant.

get.description:
The bytes. Honours `Range` (206), `If-Range` and `If-None-Match` (304).
Audio players need the range support.

put.description:
Sets or replaces the cover of one of this tenant's audio tracks (form
field `file`: PNG, JPEG or WebP). The old cover is released. 404 for a
track that is not this tenant's, 403 for a library track.

delete.description:
Takes the cover off one of this tenant's audio tracks (and deletes it
unless another track shares it). Nothing to do if it has none.

can be configured before the form is published (saving it only warns).
Ordered by id.

Ack.title: Ack
Ack.description: The confirmation a student gives to pass a step ("I have read it").

ActivityRead.title: ActivityRead
ActivityRead.description: A Moodle activity a bubble can point to, for the map editor's sidebar.

AppearanceSaved.title: AppearanceSaved
AppearanceSaved.description:
The answer to saving a map's appearance: the map, plus what the editor
should know about the trainer settings it just saved.

AppearanceUpdate.title: AppearanceUpdate
AppearanceUpdate.description: The map's whole appearance, replaced in one go (omitted means cleared).

AssessmentFormEntry.title: AssessmentFormEntry
AssessmentFormEntry.description:
An exam form the deployed content has, whatever its state: what an editor
picks from when configuring `assessments.check_in.form_id`.

AssessmentItem.title: AssessmentItem

AssessmentPolicy.title: AssessmentPolicy
AssessmentPolicy.description: One of the two exams: which form, how many attempts, how long.

AssessmentSettings.title: AssessmentSettings
AssessmentSettings.description:
The native check-in and final exam. A pass in either completes the
course (through the Moodle passback) while `exemption.enabled`.

AssessmentStep.title: AssessmentStep
AssessmentStep.description:
A native exam (see `MapSettings.assessments`): the check-in in the
welcome flow, the final exam in the closing flow (`flow_problems` refuses
the wrong one in each). The existing `quiz` step stays as a fallback until
the passback is verified.

AssetKind.title: AssetKind
AssetKind.description: What an uploaded file is for; decides its limits.

AssetRead.title: AssetRead
AssetRead.description: An asset as the API shows it. URLs are relative to the API root.

AssetUpdate.title: AssetUpdate
AssetUpdate.description: Partial update: only fields present are applied. `credit: null` clears it.

AssetUploadRead.title: AssetUploadRead
AssetUploadRead.description:
The answer to `POST /assets`: the asset, and what the editor should know
about how the upload went (`cover_dropped`: the picture found inside the
audio could not be used, so the track has no cover).

AssetUsage.title: AssetUsage
AssetUsage.description: How many things reference an asset (an asset in use cannot be deleted).

AudioInfo.title: AudioInfo
AudioInfo.description:
What a player shows about a map's music. Read-only: a draft reads it
live from the asset, a publication freezes `title`, `credit` and
`duration_seconds`.

The rest is read live on every request, for drafts and publications alike,
and is never part of a snapshot or of its hash: `available` (false when the
audio file is missing from the storage), `license` and `cover_url` (the
track's licence text, and where its cover is, if it has one).

Availability.title: Availability
Availability.description: What a bubble's Moodle activity looks like to a learner.

BubbleCreate.title: BubbleCreate
BubbleCreate.description:
A bubble for a Moodle activity (`activityId`), or a content bubble
(`kind: "content"` with `content`). `content` is kept raw here and checked
by `app.schemas.content.parse_content`, so its problems come back as one
`content_invalid` answer instead of a generic validation error.

BubbleKind.title: BubbleKind
BubbleKind.description: What a bubble opens: a Moodle activity, or content written in Rumbos.

BubbleOrderUpdate.title: BubbleOrderUpdate
BubbleOrderUpdate.description: The full desired order of a map's bubbles (the guided path).

BubbleUpdate.title: BubbleUpdate
BubbleUpdate.description:
Partial update: only fields present in the request are applied.

`icon` and `skinId` are nullable, so an explicit `null` (clear it) is
different from omitting it; use `model_fields_set` to tell them apart.
`x` and `y` always move together. `sequence` is not here on purpose: the
order endpoint is the only thing that changes it.

CatalogUnavailable.title: CatalogUnavailable
CatalogUnavailable.description: Nothing to practise for this caller. `reason` is deliberately coarse.

CourseMapOrderUpdate.title: CourseMapOrderUpdate
CourseMapOrderUpdate.description: The full desired order of a course's maps.

CourseMapRead.title: CourseMapRead
CourseMapRead.description: A course map together with its skin rules, bubbles and 3D view.

CourseMapSummary.title: CourseMapSummary
CourseMapSummary.description: A map as listed: counts its bubbles instead of carrying them.

CourseMapUpdate.title: CourseMapUpdate
CourseMapUpdate.description: Partial update: only fields present in the request are applied.

Features.title: Features
Features.description: What the caller's tenant has switched on.

HtmlStep.title: HtmlStep
HtmlStep.description:
Author-written HTML and CSS, rendered by the frontend in a sandboxed,
script-less iframe. Kept exactly as written: the write-time check refuses,
never repairs.

ImageStates.title: ImageStates
ImageStates.description: Bubble-asset ids per state. Only `available` is required.

InitialView.title: InitialView
InitialView.description: Where the camera starts: a point of the map (0-1) and a zoom.

MapAudio.title: MapAudio
MapAudio.description:
The map's background music: an `audio` asset (the tenant's own or the
library's) and how the player should play it.

MoodleStatus.title: MoodleStatus
MoodleStatus.description: How fresh the Moodle data behind a resolved map is.

PdfStep.title: PdfStep
PdfStep.description: A document asset of the tenant (kind `document`).

PublicationChanges.title: PublicationChanges
PublicationChanges.description: The draft against the current publication, for the editor's summary.

PublicationInfo.title: PublicationInfo
PublicationInfo.description: Where a map stands against what students see.

PublicationStatus.title: PublicationStatus
PublicationStatus.description: How a map's draft relates to what students see.

PublishRequest.title: PublishRequest
PublishRequest.description: `draft_hash` is the hash the editor reviewed (from `publication-state`).

QuizStep.title: QuizStep
QuizStep.description:
A Moodle quiz the student takes outside Rumbos. `cmid` is null until the
editor links one. Nothing about the attempt is ever stored here.

RestoreWarning.title: RestoreWarning
RestoreWarning.description: Something the restore had to change to fit today's data.

Role.title: Role
Role.description: What a bearer token may do (see `app.auth.principal`).

SettingsWarning.title: SettingsWarning
SettingsWarning.description:
Something saved that still needs attention. Not an error: the save went
through. Spelled in snake_case like the 422 `errors` entries.

SkinRule.title: SkinRule
SkinRule.description: On a map, bubbles of Moodle activity type `modname` use `skin_id`.

SkinUpdate.title: SkinUpdate
SkinUpdate.description: Partial update: only fields present in the request are applied.

TrainerSettings.title: TrainerSettings
TrainerSettings.description:
The practice trainer of the map: off unless the editor turns it on. The
language and level are the editor's choice, never the student's.

Welcome.title: Welcome
Welcome.description:
Defaults describe a curtain nobody configured: shown, with the default
title, no video, on the first visit only.

`steps` null or absent: the legacy fields define the curtain. `steps`
present: it defines the flow, and `title`, `message`, `video` and
`playOnEnter` are null (`play_on_enter` reads as None then). `show` applies
to both.

steps.message: Hola, te damos la bienvenida a {curso}
steps.title: Bienvenida

WelcomeDocument.title: WelcomeDocument
WelcomeDocument.description:
A document a welcome flow shows, as it is now (read live, never part of a
snapshot or its hash). `available` is false when the asset is gone, taken
down, of another kind, or its file is missing; the other fields are then
empty.

WelcomeStep.title: WelcomeStep
WelcomeStep.description: The greeting. At most one, and only as the first step.
